==Descriptions==
'''Unreleased Halloween 2020 Map''' is a map originally made for the [[Halloween 2020 Event]] instead of [[Trick or Threat Town]]. However, due to the map layout being redone to make the road smaller, it ended up being unused and instead replaced with [[Trick or Threat Town]].

==Design & Path==
'''Unreleased Halloween 2020 Map''' takes place in a large town that consists of multiple dark wooden buildings, which have neon orange windows on their sides. The town also has a cemetery and multiple fields of wheat. Various cobwebs, pumpkins and dead trees are scattered all around the map. The town is surrounded by mountains on most sides except one, which leads to an ocean. This also has a river leading into it, which splits the town in half.

The path starts and ends at a cave. The path takes multiple turns, avoiding the buildings present on the map and goes over the green river.
